newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson profits leap in first half.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson profits leap in first half.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group AB LM Ericsson on Thursday posted a whopping 44 percent leap in first half pre-tax earnings to 6.095 billion crowns ($780.6 million), exceeding market expectations by around one billion crowns.
The share market immediately launched a buying spree for the mobile phone giant, driving the share price up more than 10 percent.
Ericsson said order bookings rose 39 percent during the period to 87.76 billion crowns.

"Ericsson is still developing positively. New orders rose for the 23rd successive quarter and that means the market believes our product development is competitive," said Chief Executive Lars Ramqvist.

Sales of mobile telephones leapt more than 100 percent in the period and Ramqvist said Ericsson's global market share of mobile phones had risen four percentage points to 16 percent in the first half year. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
